entities.summary: El Argar is an archeological site for the Early Bronze Age Argaric culture developed in the municipality of Antas, in Almeria which was believed to have been active from about 2200 BC to 1500 BC. It is part of the archaeological zone of El Argar and La Gerundia, and it gives name to the Argaric culture.
